heroText: Dhaka works best as a base in Bangladesh when you anchor days around Lalbagh Fort, Ahsan Manzil and Dhakeshwari Temple. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Dhaka Hazrat Shahjalal handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

stayOverview: Start with Gulshan for the easiest first Dhaka stay, then compare Banani and Dhanmondi when price, nightlife, quieter evenings or transfer timing matter more than being beside every major sight.
hotelIntro: Dhaka hotel choice is mostly about repeat journeys: use Gulshan for sightseeing, Banani for a different local base, and Dhanmondi or Old Dhaka when views, parking, airport timing or longer stays matter.
rentalCars: Do not rent a car for central Dhaka unless parking and traffic are part of the plan; use one mainly for regional day trips.
